description: The owner applied gate-change-approved with `ao owner-label apply`, whose record names the head, but the record was edited afterwards: an edited record never counts (#62).

comments.author: dflippojr
comments.body:
Owner applied `gate-change-approved` at head {head}. A later push invalidates it.

<!-- owner-label gate-change-approved head={head} -->

expect.title: 2 hits, not approved
expect.reason: but no unedited head record from the owner was posted at or after it, and the label alone doesn't count
